extraction_notes: Ordering-code identity is explicit on p. 1: 2N7002ET1G, SOT-23, 3000/Tape & Reel. The datasheet title is the base device 2N7002E; the supplied MPN preserves the ordering suffix.
onsemi is identified in the datasheet body and copyright notice; the electrical-characteristics manufacturer heading is onsemi.com.
The device is an N-channel MOSFET. The package pin assignment on p. 5 is pin 1 gate, pin 2 source, pin 3 drain.
Electrical characteristics are headed TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise specified. Table values retain their published typical, minimum, and maximum meanings in source_kind and citations.
VGS(th) has no published typical value, so threshold_typ is null. Its min/max test condition is VGS = VDS and ID = 0.25 A.
The RDS(on) table publishes typical and maximum values for both VGS/ID pairs. Because the strict schema has one resistance object per point, each pair is represented twice to preserve both meanings.
CISS is 26.7 pF typical and 40 pF maximum at the stated bias; the schema field stores the typical value and this note preserves the published maximum.

Figure 1 provides typical output curves for the selected VGS values, but does not state TJ in the figure. It is retained with that condition explicitly marked as unstated rather than claiming 25 degC.
Figure 2 transfer extraction uses only the explicitly labelled TJ = 25 degC curve; the figure does not state VDS.

Figure 7 capacitance curves are typical at TJ = 25 degC and VGS = 0 V. Figure 8 is a typical gate-charge curve at TJ = 25 degC and ID = 0.25 A. Figure 9 uses the explicitly labelled TJ = 25 degC diode curve with logarithmic current axis.
The supplied datasheet publishes no thermal junction-to-case value; only junction-to-ambient thermal resistance is given on p. 1 and is not represented by this strict schema.
The datasheet does not publish reverse-recovery time trr in the supplied electrical-characteristics tables.
